profiles.scope: Profiled one-layer component GPU intervals, not unprofiled throughput or serving latency.

definitions.cross_request: Positive-row payload kernel intervals from a different request and different slot intersecting ExpertGEMM intervals on the same GPU; union intersections avoid double counting.
definitions.cross_slot: Includes intra-request chunk overlap for pipeline_graph and inter-request overlap for request_pipeline.
definitions.transport_limit: GIN SendRequest/SendReply intervals include flush/completion waits; nonempty payload proves bytes exist, not continuous wire transfer throughout the interval.
definitions.pure_local_payload: ReduceReply is FFN-local NVLink reduction with no readiness polling loop; positive source rows prove useful local work.
definitions.unproven_payload: PackRows requires exact expert counts to establish nonempty work and is conservatively absent from strict proof.
definitions.clocks: All overlap comparisons are within one process/device; no cross-node timestamp alignment.

source_stream_evidence.scope: E mixed, one source GPU, selected requests 20–23. R21 payload copy overlaps R22 SendRequest by 6.080 us and finishes 259.840 us before that send completes. Selection illustrates the independent-stream dependency change; not a percentile or network bandwidth claim.

interpretation.overlap: Positive-row payload-kernel intervals intersect expert GEMMs across requests on each FFN GPU. Most broad overlap is SendReply intervals, which include completion waits. Pure ReduceReply overlap is a stronger local-copy/reduction proof; packing counts are candidate intervals because per-expert row counts were not saved. Incoming NIC DMA can overlap GEMM without a local FFN transfer kernel.
interpretation.remaining_tails: The profiled large run has 10 of 64 pipeline GPU responses over 30 ms, including source SendRequest intervals up to 95.863 ms and FFN SendReply up to 71.056 ms. ReplyConsumedCredit stays below 0.491 ms. The profiled mixed run has 0 of 150 over 30 ms, but separate unprofiled mixed runs still have a 103 ms outlier. E fixes source cross-slot ordering; neither these traces nor changing the backend establishes the cause of intermittent transport completion tails.
interpretation.measurement_boundary: Do not compare profiled durations to unprofiled throughput, nor sum timestamps across nodes. Kernel names locate the long interval but do not identify which internal GIN call or NIC component caused it.
